“But… with my current Mental Will Index, even if I kill a Ninth Stage Void Creature, it won’t be of much help to me. Could it be that in the future, I’ll have to seek out a Void Creature Monarch?”

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

Void Creature Monarch? In his more than three hundred years of roaming the Void Secret Realm, Lin Yuan had only encountered one. The rest of the time, it was just hearsay.

For the majority of Demonic Divine Masters, encountering a Void Creature Monarch is not a good thing.

For example, this time, if Lin Yuan had not come, the outcome for those nineteen Demonic Divine Masters was almost certain.

...

…

“The stronger the Spirit Will, the greater the Combat Power that can be unleashed and the better the soul defense that can be realized. In summary, the level of Spirit Will has a wide-ranging impact.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In battles with peers of the same tier, it’s not too bad if the Spirit Wills are not much different.

But if there is a significant gap, under the premise of similar underlying strengths, the mere instant of contact and clash of Spirit Wills would cause the weaker side to be suppressed.

If the gap in Spirit Will is very substantial, there would be no need even to fight; a single glance could defeat the enemy.

With Lin Yuan’s current twenty million points in the Mental Will Index, if he harbors the intent to kill, it would take just one look to deal with lives below Tier 11.

Compared to material attacks, the oppression from Spirit Will in terms of soul attacks is more intangible.

A mere segment of a Supreme Being’s body, even separated by the Virtual World, could drive countless middle and low-tier Evolvers mad.

The current Lin Yuan might not overall be in the domain of the Supreme Beings, but at least in the aspect of Spirit Will, he is already close to being comparable.

…

“However, these Void Creatures…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze grew solemn as he looked at the Void Secret Realm before him.

Three hundred years ago, at the Third Realm of Fusion of Time and Space, Lin Yuan entered the Void Secret Realm through a Scroll artifact.

He did not understand much about the formation of this Secret Realm, only knowing that whoever opened this Secret Realm had Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule achievements of at least the Sixth Realm.

But now?

Lin Yuan’s Fusion of Time and Space has reached the Fifth Realm. Even though he still falls short of the Mystic Realm Founder’s realm, he could see some essence of the Void Secret Realm before him.

In Lin Yuan’s vision, the so-called Void Secret Realm was just a ‘net’ in the Boundless Void.

And the Void Creatures are lives from outside of the Boundless Void, that is, from the Dimension Gap.

In theory, these gap beings absolutely cannot enter dimensions like the Boundless Void.

But because of the ‘net’ of the Void Secret Realm, it allows these gap beings a chance to enter. Once they do, they’re trapped like fish on a chopping board, unable to escape.

The fate waiting for those gap beings is either to struggle for survival or to be killed by Demonic Divine Masters and become nourishment for promotion.

“Impressive.”

Lin Yuan praised inwardly. Such methods were secondary; what was truly remarkable was the attraction and imprisonment of dimension gap beings, providing many Demonic Divine Masters with kills, fostering the foundation for the rise of the Demonic powers in the Boundless Void.

In a sense, Lin Yuan was also a beneficiary.

“Life within dimensions and life outside dimensions have completely opposite essences; they can complement each other.”

“Demonic Divine Masters can gain an increase in Spirit Will by killing Void Creatures.”

“If those Void Creatures can kill Demonic Divine Masters, they too would receive some sort of enhancement.”

“However, because the Void Secret Realm is within the Boundless Void, and the Demonic Divine Masters are endless, it has led to the rampant slaughter of Void Creatures.”

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

…

While Lin Yuan was contemplating.

The Lord of the Three Yin approached hastily.

“Master Master.”

The Lord of the Three Yin was terrified, since the aura emitting from here was too horrific, as well as the sight of Demonic Divine Masters fleeing like stray dogs.

“What?”

Upon arriving, the Lord of the Three Yin immediately noticed the enormous nest in the distance, and the dark, crudely aggressive entrance of the hole.

The entire nest was nearly penetrated by this hole. Even though the Lord of the Three Yin did not know how the hole formed, it could vaguely sense the terrifying traces left on it.

It was as if an unparalleled giant reached out his right hand towards this giant nest, obliterating all resistance in its path.

The more it observed, the more the Lord of the Three Yin trembled.

And now, only Lin Yuan was left on the field. The rest of the Demonic Divine Masters had all fled. This also suggested that Lin Yuan’s power must surpass those of the Demonic Divine Masters.

“Let’s go.”

Lin Yuan contemplated for a moment and then headed in a different direction.

Since all the Void Creatures had been killed, this place held no further value for Lin Yuan, so naturally, he would not stay.

…

Elsewhere in the Void Secret Realm.

The Eight-Handed Lord and the Heavenly Python Divine Master regrouped.

The nineteen Demonic Divine Masters scattered in their escape. Seeing that the Taiyang Divine Master did not pursue them, they breathed a sigh of relief.

Especially the Heavenly Python Divine Master, who had directly experienced a glimpse of Lin Yuan’s pressure akin to the collapse of the void. Originally prepared with various excuses, planning to somewhat ‘coerce’ using the nineteen Demonic Divine Masters, he did not hesitate to bow and quicken his retreat.

“Heavenly Python, what exactly happened? Why were you so cowardly at the end?” the Eight-Handed Lord said with some dissatisfaction.

If it weren’t for the Heavenly Python Divine Master taking the lead in fleeing, their eighteen Demonic Divine Masters wouldn’t have dispersed so quickly. They could have held on for a while longer.

The Eight-Handed Lord could tell that the Taiyang Divine Master, in order to suppress the three Void Creatures in his palm, likely did not have the capacity to deal with others, which should have been their opportunity.
